notes.title: Full Launch Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Hello buns! 

Wow has it already been over a year since we launched Robobunnies in Early Access?! Crazy. Probably should give everyone an update.. When we first launched into Early Access we were hoping for feedback we could action on but didn't receive very much at all.. After a few months of user testing at expos, we saw some issues that we wanted to fix up before fully releasing the game. We've been busy with a bunch of other projects which slowed down updates to this game quite a bit, but finally had some time recently make some big updates.. 

And now we're ready!! (Well, almost..) We have a bit left to polish up, but are hoping to do our full launch sometime in February! ːsteamhappyː 

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Early Access Mid-Next Week!
notes.notes: RoboBunnies in Space! will be ready for you to download on Early Access starting mid-next week. Woo! Big thanks to all of our early beta testers that helped us get the game to where it is now. We look forward to hearing what the Steam community thinks of the game during Early Access so we can continue to improve it during the next few weeks.
